data.title: 堀京子 · 放学到主妇的十分钟切换
data.description: 【家中玄关·放学后】京子刚回家，长发已随手扎起，身上仍是整齐的校服。她一手拎着书包，另一手从墙上挂钩取下折叠的蓝色围裙，转头确认走廊里的动静。画面只呈现她本人，以木质鞋柜和挂钩交代玄关。
data.action: 一手拎书包，一手取下折叠围裙，束起长发后看向走廊。
data.promptProse: Kyouko Hori arrives home and reaches for the folded blue apron on the wall hook while holding her schoolbag in the other hand. Her chestnut hair is casually tied back above the white wing-collar shirt and dark school blazer. Only she appears in the medium portrait, turning toward the hallway. Soft daylight reveals the wooden shoe cabinet and apron folds, with a compact hook shadow against the wall and a darker corridor beyond.
